rules.title: Hot Path Allocation Budget
rules.check: Hot paths MUST NOT allocate more than 100 bytes per operation.
rules.bad_example:
// Inside a loop
var data = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 }; // Allocates on heap
rules.good_example:
// Inside a loop
Span<int> data = stackalloc int[] { 1, 2, 3 }; // No heap allocation

rules.title: Struct for Small Value Types
rules.check: Types smaller than 16 bytes with value semantics MUST be struct.
rules.bad_example: public class Point { public int X; public int Y; } // Heap allocation
rules.good_example: public readonly struct Point { public int X { get; init; } public int Y { get; init; } }

rules.title: ArrayPool for Temporary Arrays
rules.check: Temporary arrays in hot paths MUST use ArrayPool.
rules.bad_example:
byte[] buffer = new byte[1024]; // Allocation pressure
Process(buffer);

rules.title: StringBuilder for Loop Concatenation
rules.check: String concatenation in loops MUST use StringBuilder.
rules.bad_example:
string s = "";
foreach (var item in items) s += item; // O(N^2) allocations

rules.title: Avoid Boxing
rules.check: Value types MUST NOT be boxed in hot paths.

rules.title: Sealed Classes
rules.check: Non-inherited classes MUST be sealed for devirtualization.

rules.title: Readonly Structs
rules.check: Immutable structs MUST be marked readonly.
rules.bad_example: public struct Vector3 { public float X; ... }
rules.good_example: public readonly struct Vector3 { public float X { get; init; } ... }

rules.title: Span for Slicing
rules.check: String/Array slicing MUST use Span<T> or Memory<T>.
rules.bad_example: string sub = text.Substring(0, 5); // New string allocation

rules.title: Avoid In-Memory LINQ in Hot Paths
rules.check: In-memory LINQ (LINQ-to-Objects) MUST NOT be used in critical hot paths. Use explicit loops instead.
rules.bad_example:
// In tight loop over in-memory collection
return items.Where(x => x > 10).Sum(); // Allocates iterators

rules.title: Cache Regex Instances
rules.check: Regex instances MUST be static and compiled.

rules.title: Frozen Collections
rules.check: Use FrozenDictionary / FrozenSet for read-only lookup tables initialized at startup.

rules.title: SearchValues
rules.check: Use SearchValues<T> for repeated character/byte searches instead of Contains.
rules.bad_example:
// Allocates array and searches linearly each time
bool hasVowel = input.IndexOfAny(['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']) >= 0;

rules.title: Async State Machine Overhead
rules.check: Avoid async in tight loops. Consider batching operations to reduce state machine allocations.
